description: Bring your Figma workflows for creating, reviewing, and implementing designs into your ChatGPT and Codex conversations. Send your product screens to Figma where they become editable layers using your designs system components. Share these designs and collaborate with your team, or send them back to Codex to implement the designs in your codebase. You can also create and edit polished decks in Figma Slides, or generate diagrams in FigJam.
